candidates.name: Giraffe Japan (nightclub)
candidates.why: The club young visitors in Osaka are actually posting from right now: reopened in 2025 on the 5F of the Nakaza Cuidaore building on Dotonbori, new sound and lights, crowd packed most nights. Two minutes' walk from Jankara and Round1, so it slots straight into a Namba night.

candidates.dates: Fri 25 Dec is the strongest night (Christmas-night parties + weekend); Mon–Thu still busy with tourists
candidates.price: Entry with 1 drink included at the door per Google reviews; reseller foreigner tickets run roughly ¥800–1,800 incl. drinks; VIP table packages sold separately. Women often cheaper
candidates.booking: Buy foreigner entry/drink tickets online (Klook/Expedia/official) a few days ahead for Thu 24 and Fri 25; walk-in fine other nights

candidates.first_last: Opens 22:00, closes 04:00: either taxi home (~15 min to Kujo) or stay until the first train

candidates.booking: Walk in; split into pairs or fours
candidates.group_of_8: Hard as one group; split up, then regroup at the Fudo statue

candidates.name: Ura-Namba drinking district
candidates.why: Where young Osakans actually drink in Minami. A grid of standing bars, horumon and yakiton counters south-east of Namba, between Sennichimae-dori and Nansan-dori, Takashimaya and Kuromon. Cheap drinks and lots of bars close together for a crawl; many stay open to 02:00–03:00.
candidates.dates: Mon 21–Thu 24 easier; Fri 25 + year-end bonenkai season means some bars are full
candidates.price: ¥2,000–3,500 per person across 3 stops; standing-bar drinks ¥400–600
candidates.booking: Walk in. For a sit-down izakaya for all 8 on Fri 25, book a few days ahead (Hot Pepper)
candidates.group_of_8: Split into 2×4 for standing bars; regroup at bigger izakaya
candidates.hours: Most 17:00–24:00; several to 03:00 (e.g. Yusei ura-Namba to 03:00)
candidates.first_last: 5–10 min walk back to Namba for the Hanshin Namba line to Kujo

notes: Osaka · night: Base logic: Kujo (Nishi-ku) is 2 stops (~5 min) from Osaka-Namba on the Hanshin Namba line and on the Metro Chuo line via Hommachi, so Minami (Dotonbori, Ura-Namba, Amemura, Shinsaibashi) is home turf. A taxi from Namba is ~10–15 min, ~¥2,000 per car with the 20% late-night surcharge (split 4 ways); walking takes ~40 min. Pair the nights: (1) Mon 21: Tenma crawl from 17:30, then Shin-Umeda Shokudogai, then OWL Umeda (open nightly). (2) Minami nights: Hozenji, then Ura-Namba crawl, then Jankara, then Giraffe 22:00–04:00, then Round1 Sennichimae (24h) karaoke/Spo-Cha until the first train ~05:00. (3) Amemura night: Space Station, Triangle Park, then Circus (Thu–Sat only). Fukushima is the closest quality izakaya area to Kujo (taxi ~10 min). Kyoto (w3): do Pontocho at dusk and Kiyamachi bars after a Kyoto day, but leave Kawaramachi by ~23:00 to connect to Kujo (verify last trains on Jorudan); Kitsune Kyoto only works as an all-nighter with the first train back. Christmas: Thu 24 is a couples' date night (restaurants full, clubs run Xmas parties); Fri 25 = Christmas plus the weekend plus peak year-end bonenkai, so it is the biggest party night of the stay. Book Giraffe tickets ahead and reserve any izakaya for 8 that night. Rules: drinking/club age is 20+, carry original passports (clubs and Round1 check ID; under-18s barred 22:00–05:00 in Osaka). Many clubs refuse shorts/sandals and visible tattoos. Ignore street touts in Shinsaibashi/Dotonbori. Jankara stops serving alcohol at midnight. Budget: ¥1,500–3,000 per person for a standing-bar crawl, club entry ~¥1,000–3,500 incl. 1 drink, so a full night is ~¥5,000–8,000 each. Free Round1/Jankara app memberships cut prices (w10). Year-end: Dec 21–26 is before the New Year closures, so nightlife runs normally. CORRECTION: the osakatourism.org guide cited for Shin-Umeda Shokudogai and Space Station does not name them; treat both as single-signal (Google Maps) until re-checked.
